candidates.title: TG SAFE suspends FSSAI licenses of nine food establishments in Hyderabad for food safety violations
candidates.excerpt: Officials identified multiple food safety violations, including spoilt and contaminated meat and vegetables, pest infestations, unhygienic conditions, expired products, and poor record maintenance

candidates.title: Hyderabad: Woman, father killed in road accident in Mailardevpally days before wedding
candidates.excerpt: A 21-year-old woman and her father were killed after a container vehicle allegedly hit their motorcycle on Katedan Road in Mailardevpally on Wednesday night. The woman’s wedding was reportedly scheduled for early next month, police said.

candidates.title: Hyderabad: Five arrested for murder near Ganesh mandapam in Tukaramgate
candidates.excerpt: Lallaguda police arrested five persons for allegedly murdering Burugu Karthik near a Ganesh mandapam in Tukaramgate on Sunday night. Police said the murder was linked to a long-standing grudge over Karthik assisting another man in his love marriage in 2023.

candidates.title: Pakistan Navy vessel collides with Indian warship in Arabian Sea
candidates.excerpt: India summons Pakistan envoy and lodges strong protest over “unacceptable and unprofessional conduct”; Pakistani vessel approached Indian ship at high speed but suffered damage in collision and returned to harbour; Indian warship remains deployed
